confirm.title: Update {device_name} firmware
confirm.description: The Everything Presence Pro Grid integration expects firmware **{required_version}** but **{device_name}** is running **{current_version}**. Click **Submit** to install the required firmware over the air now. The device will reboot once flashing completes — this usually takes about a minute. Some integration features may not work correctly until the firmware is updated.

failed.title: Update failed
failed.description:
The firmware update for **{device_name}** did not complete. Most likely cause: the device went offline or the OTA download failed mid-flash. Check the device, then click **Submit** to try again.

Details: {error}

progress.installing: Installing firmware **{required_version}** on **{device_name}**. The device will download the firmware over the air, reboot, and reconnect. This usually takes about a minute.

firmware_ahead.title: {device_name} integration update required
firmware_ahead.description: {device_name} is running firmware **{current_version}** but the Everything Presence Pro Grid integration is pinned to **{required_version}**. Update the integration via HACS so it can talk to the newer firmware. Some integration features may not work correctly until the integration is updated.
